value.message: Manage users in the conditional script writer group
Configure users that need to be part of the conditional script writer group. Once users are configured, you can quickly schedule removal of users who don’t need scripting capability.

Users with scripting permissions granted from groups other than the conditional script writer group will not have permissions affected. Scheduling removal will also turn off auto-assignment of new users in conditional script writer group.
For instances with many users, removing the conditional script writer group can take several hours and may slow down your instance. You can schedule this to run outside of regular business hours.
